name: SVG Image Widget Crop
description: Excludes SVG images from the Image Widget Crop UI, since vector images cannot be cropped.
project_description:
Module essentially skips or excludes SVG images when using the Image Widget Crop module, as they can't be cropped.

 Inspired by: https://www.drupal.org/project/image_widget_crop/issues/3034165 

 Requirements 
 Requires the Image Widget Crop module and also assumes you have the SVG Image module to enable SVG support.

 Usage 
 Install module via Composer and enable module like any other contributed module.

 

composer require drupal/svg_image_widget_crop

drush en svg_image_widget_crop
